script:
Tech layoffs just crossed 196,000 for 2026 — and AI is the reason why.

Trackers now put this year's tech job cuts near 196,000 workers, with Oracle, Amazon, and Meta leading the wave as companies restructure around AI. More than half of those cuts are tied directly to AI-driven workforce changes — companies cutting roles while pouring billions into AI infrastructure and hiring for AI-specific positions instead.

It's not just engineers losing jobs either — recruiting, support, and middle-management roles are getting hit hardest as AI tools absorb that work.

If you're in tech, the message is clear: the skills that get you hired in 2027 look different from the ones that got you hired in 2022.

I'm Nova. Stay ahead — for more AI news, subscribe to the link in the bio.
